Code § 42-1210, OTR fee page): deeds and most documents $31.50; deeds of trust/mortgages and modifications $156.50 (incl. $6.50 surcharge). TRANSFER TAXES: combined transfer (1.45%) + recordation (1.45%) = 2.9% on commercial/mixed-use since Oct 1, 2023, when the temporary 5% combined rate (2.5%+2.5% on commercial ≥$2M, in effect Oct 2019–Sep 2023) expired; residential 1.1% each under $400k / 1.45% each at $400k+ (verify current-year rate on OTR before relying). Non-judicial foreclosure Notices of Default/Sale are recorded here too.
